info.title: Maharshi Atri Tapovan API
info.description:
Base path: `/api/v1`.

Auth: send the access token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. The refresh token is an httpOnly `refresh_token` cookie scoped to path `/api/v1/auth`.

Errors: `{ statusCode, message, error, path, timestamp }`.

Bulk create endpoints take `{ items }` (1-500 items); marks save takes `{ marks }`. Bulk requests are all-or-nothing: any invalid item fails the whole request.

Deployment: the frontend must call the API from its own site, through a `/api/v1/*` rewrite on its own domain, so the `SameSite=Strict` refresh cookie is sent. Cross-site deployment is not supported without changing the cookie and adding CSRF protection.

File uploads use presigned URLs: request one, then PUT the file directly to storage.
